body: Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-06 22:12Z; my own error, corrected after Opus2 #4693). The one-decision-owner-per-feature rule covers a feature's own design and scope decisions. It does NOT cover repository commit, review or gate authority. On 22:11Z I told Sol-a7bb that M1's owner's "clean-carry adoption proof instead of a fresh review pair" governed. That contradicted .claude/commands/review-changes.md:85-87 ("committed afresh as a new candidate whose parent is the current master, which is frozen, gated and reviewed as its own input") and CLAUDE.md condition 1. Loosening a commit-rule condition needs (a)/(b)/(c) plus Greg's own recorded word. Before deferring to an owner, check whether the matter is commit/review/gate authority text; if it is, the rule text governs and only Greg can loosen it. On 2026-11-06 the option was put to Greg as a question; the default stays fresh pairs.
